fields-all.note: The run is compared in the json format. In the default, tab and vcf formats every data row agrees, and five header description lines differ: Ensembl VEP's VCF header parser (ensembl-io BaseVCF4.pm:135, :146) removes every < and > of a header line and cuts a description at its first =, so AC_het, AC_hom, AF_het and AF_hom read '... with a heteroplasmy level ' and common_low_heteroplasmy loses its comparison signs, where vep-rs writes the file's description as written; the reference's default.txt.gz, tab.txt.gz and vcf.vcf.gz are kept beside the compared file. The fields-subset run compares, in every format, fields whose descriptions carry no such sign, among them a field most rows lack and a flag field.
